topic: Introduction to electronic instruments and advantages
syllabus_extract: Introduction to electronic instruments and advantages.
specific_objectives: 20.3.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the construction and operation of DMM & CRO.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of DMM and CRO front panel controls; Safety: High voltage caution; Supervision: Instructor monitors connections.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an electronic instrument?
Name two advantages of electronic instruments over mechanical ones.
Why is calibration important for measurement accuracy?

development.content:
Definition of electronic instruments
Advantages over mechanical types
General construction principles
Signal conditioning basics
Accuracy and precision concepts

Digital Multimeter (DMM) construction
DMM operation modes
Cathode Ray Oscilloscope (CRO) construction
CRO operation principles
Comparison of DMM and CRO

Safety precautions for electronic instruments
Common errors in measurement
Maintenance and storage requirements
Troubleshooting basic faults
Summary of key advantages

summary_questions: Explain the main advantage of a DMM over an analog multimeter.
Describe the role of the electron beam in a CRO.
List three safety precautions when operating high-voltage instruments.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the knowledge of DMM and CRO principles will assist in the study of Spectrum analyzers and function generators in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: Functions and operation of DMM, Spectrum analyzer and function generator.
